subject: Workplace Skills
title: Avoiding the Blame Game
description: Learn Avoiding the Blame Game in one minute.

hook.text: The project failed. Three people immediately started explaining why it wasn't their fault.

buildup.text: Blame cultures destroy learning. When people fear punishment, they hide mistakes instead of fixing them.

discovery.text: Shift from 'whose fault?' to 'what happened and how do we prevent it?' Process fixes outlast scapegoats.

twist.text: Owning your part of a failure publicly earns more respect than deflecting. Vulnerability signals strength.

climax.text: When blamed unfairly, respond with facts: 'Here's what I was responsible for and what I delivered.'

punchline.text: Own your part. Correct the record calmly with facts.

quiz.question: How should you respond when blamed unfairly for a failure?
options: Blame someone else to redirect attention
State facts about your responsibilities and deliverables calmly
Accept the blame to avoid conflict
